notes: «- المعنى -» is an editor gloss and is left out; «قالا» makes سليمان بن حرب and مسدد co-transmitters on one level
«حفظته عن مسدد ثم اتفقا» and «وحديث مسدد أتم» are remarks about the version Musaddad gave, not a second isnad, so they add no group
the Prophet's words end at a Companion's narration
